steps.name: Step 1 — Create pipeline with state variables summary (String), count (Number), tags (List) — verify via STATE panel
Step 2 — Code node Input combobox includes summary
Step 3 — Code node script reads elitea_state.get('summary', ...) and ends with a bare 3-key dict-literal expression as its LAST statement

Step 4 — Code node Output combobox maps returned keys to summary, count, tags (order-independent membership check — the combobox renders each selected variable as its own chip with NO textual separator between chips, confirmed live this session, so a comma-split can't be used; chip order is insertion order, not a stable contract) and structured output is enabled
Step 5 — Execute the pipeline via the embedded chat
Step 6 — Open Run Details, select the Code node timeline step
